source.quote: We illustrate by finding two inequivalent indefinite ternary forms of determinant -128 of the same genus (see Corollary 22). It is easy to see that the genus of f = diag{-1, 64, 2}, namely I_{2,1}(2 x 64), contains two spinor genera and hence two classes, namely f and f * Delta(3). [...] The matrix (51b) is therefore a representative for the second class in this genus.
